title: Skill graph
description: The skill graph of a module, skill-graph.yaml at the root of its folder: the module's skills, what a learner needs before each one, how the platform can know a learner's command of each, which anchor skills of the shared taxonomy each one teaches, the names of the tiers, and the skills that the module had once and has no more. The tier of a skill is computed from the prerequisites, never written, and module-kit puts it into the module's package. Every field is open but retired_skills, since the skill map shows them.

tiers.description: The names of the tiers, in order from tier 1. The tiers past the last name are shown by their numbers, and a name past the last tier names none.

title.description: What the skill is called, in the module's explanation language.

description.description: What a learner who has the skill can do, in the module's explanation language.

prerequisites.description: The skills that a learner needs before this one, all of them: skills of the module by local ID, and anchor skills of the shared taxonomy by their IDs. A skill with none leaves this field out.

teaches.description: The anchor skills of the shared taxonomy that this skill teaches: a learner who has this skill can do what the description of each says. Other modules build on them, and the learner model decides by such skills whether a learner has them. A skill that teaches none leaves this field out.

assessability.description: How the platform can know a learner's command of the skill: verdict, when its tasks are checked against a key or a predicate; rubric, when work on it gets feedback by the author's rubric and no verdict; none, when it is practised and not assessed.

additionalProperties.description: A skill of the module, under its local ID.

skills.description: The module's skills, each under its local ID. Their order carries no meaning.

replaced_by.description: The skills of this version that took over what the retired skill taught: one for a skill renamed, several for a skill split. Empty when none did: then a learner's progress in it moves to no skill.

additionalProperties.description: A retired skill, under the local ID it had.

retired_skills.description: The skills that earlier versions of the module had and this one has no more, under the IDs they had: the table by which a learner's progress moves to the skills of this version. An entry stays in every later version, and its ID never names another skill.
